statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional chest tightness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
A mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic events or ischemic triggers contributing to these symptoms
The claim was denied under reason code CO-50
The denial reason is that the service does not meet coverage criteria for medical necessity
